description: Get a single asset cost record by ID - the record type shown on the main AssetLab "Expenses" page. Returns amount, cost_date, category, description, invoice_number, po_number, and related asset, site, building, and work_order. Distinct from get_expense (project-scoped expenses without invoice/PO). Amounts are bare numbers with no currency: call get_organization_settings for currency_code before stating one.
name: get_asset_cost
title: Get asset cost
